optical_input.archive_role: diagnostic rounded samples; solver uses unrounded analytic samples
optical_input.unobserved_between_sample_changes: not generally bounded; compare declared fixture truth

lifecycle.reset_policy: finish prior interval, then initialize reference/filter without events; retain threshold map and cumulative run counters
lifecycle.new_stream_policy: new sensor state and counters; seed regenerates threshold map; caller supplies stream_id and epoch

stages.candidate_resource_guard: abort run on limit; no truncated successful run

events.timestamp: signed int64 nanoseconds; integer epoch + rounded run-relative ns
events.quantization: nearest ties-to-even; at most 0.5 ns plus binary64 solver roundoff
events.ordering: unquantized (t,y,x,p), stable ties; sequence preserves order after quantization

candidates.timestamp: signed int64 nanoseconds; integer epoch + rounded run-relative ns
candidates.quantization: nearest ties-to-even; at most 0.5 ns plus binary64 solver roundoff
candidates.ordering: unquantized (t,y,x,p), stable ties; sequence preserves order after quantization

truth.timestamp: signed int64 nanoseconds; integer epoch + rounded run-relative ns
truth.quantization: nearest ties-to-even; at most 0.5 ns plus binary64 solver roundoff
truth.ordering: unquantized (t,y,x,p), stable ties; sequence preserves order after quantization

comparison.reference: same optical fixture, exact area and continuous trajectory, nominal ideal thresholds, same reset schedule

limits: generic mathematical profiles, no camera calibration
no noise process, leak or readout arbiter
held nonideal input is a sampling approximation
analytic edge and finite-rise pulse only
offline CPU run, no realtime performance claim
viewer is event accumulation, not intensity reconstruction
